status: DRAFT — review with the cyber team. Implemented in data-ai/scoring.py (reference implementation for src/server/services/scoring.ts).
categoryScore: Average tier of the questions in the category.
functionScore: Average tier of the categories in the function (simple average).
overallScore: currentTier = average of the function scores that were assessed (each function weighted equally), rounded to 1 decimal.

targetTier.rule: base by company size, +1 for regulated / high-risk industries, max 4. Applied to every function.

riskLevel.rule: overallGap = average over assessed functions of max(0, targetTier - functionScore), so a strong function cannot hide a weak one. Map the gap to a level, then raise one level if any critical question (critical: true in questions.json) is answered 'no'. Max 'critical'.

heatmap: Each question answered 'no' or 'partially' is one issue. impact: high if critical or targetTier >= 4, medium if the question's cisIg is 1, else low. likelihood: high if 'no', medium if 'partially'.

recommendedPlan.status: NEW — not in the web app yet. Proposed extra field for the AI response.
recommendedPlan.highRiskIndustry: 1 if industry is in targetTier.highRiskIndustries, else 0
recommendedPlan.scopePoints: 0.5 per requested service beyond the first (max 1)
recommendedPlan.cisMapping: Starter ≈ CIS Implementation Group 1, Professional ≈ IG2, Enterprise ≈ IG3
